attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Empire continues its skirmishes with the Free Coast Alliance.","severity":"minor","reason":"briefing says only 'at war'; 'skirmishes' and ongoing activity are not reported"},{"span":"The Driftwood Tribe holds their three scattered posts.","severity":"minor","reason":"'scattered' and 'posts' are added detail; briefing gives only 3 settlements"},{"span":"They maintain their grip on most of the region.","severity":"minor","reason":"restates the briefing's 'controlling most of the region' as an ongoing status, which is mild and acceptable but adds little; the Alliance 'clings' repeats old news"}],"voice":3,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":3,"comment":"Facts are mostly accurate and the guesses are properly framed, but the wit is thin and generic, the second and third items are flat restatements of faction sizes, and the Alliance two-town line repeats old news.
